text: Through one academic year ( Fall and Spring Semesters, 36 weeks in total) of study, students can have a good command of Chinese in listening, speaking, reading and writing, and achieve the entry level of bachelor's programs (offered in Chinese) at School of International Education BUU. Condition of Completion Students who have completed all the courses and passed all the course examinations will be granted a certificate of completion from School of International Education of Beijing Union University. Application Period All year round.
